def is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool:
    """True when `name` is a single plain file name: non-empty, not `.` or `..`,
    with no `/`, no `\\`, no NUL and no drive colon, so it cannot leave `notes`."""
    ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
    ex is_plain_name("") == False
    ex is_plain_name(".") == False
    ex is_plain_name("..") == False
    ex is_plain_name("../secret.txt") == False
    ex is_plain_name("/etc/passwd") == False
    ex is_plain_name("a/../../secret.txt") == False
    ex is_plain_name("a\\b") == False
    if name == "" or name == "." or name == "..":
        return False
    for c in name.chars():
        if c == "/" or c == "\\" or c == ":" or c == "\0":
            return False
    return True

def read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Text of the file `name` inside the directory `notes`, read through
    `with fs = fs.sub("notes")`. Returns "" if `name` is not a plain name
    (see is_plain_name), or if the file is missing or unreadable."""
    post out.byte_len() >= 0
    if not is_plain_name(name):
        return ""
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        return fs.read_text(name) else ""
